settings.overviewDescription: Welcome and goodbye messages, with an optional random-GIF pool. Save GIFs by right-clicking a message and picking the "Save GIF" app command.

descriptions.embed: The name of a saved embed from the embed builder. Placeholders: {{list}}
descriptions.components: The name of a saved message from the component builder - takes priority over the saved embed. Placeholders: {{list}}
descriptions.pingJoin: Mention the joining user above the message
descriptions.pingRoles: Roles to mention above the message
descriptions.pingUsers: Users to mention above the message

actions.testDesc: Sends the real message to the configured channel, treating you as the member
actions.gifsDesc: Attach a random saved GIF to every message. Save GIFs by right-clicking any message with an image and picking the "Save GIF" app command.

test.failed: Nothing sent - set a channel and make sure the referenced saved message still exists.

guide.title: Welcome Setup Guide
guide.intro: Work through the sections below. Each section goes live the moment you turn it on.
guide.advertText: **New here?** The Setup Guide walks you through welcome and goodbye messages.

sectionDesc.welcome: Greet members the moment they join. Without a saved embed or CV2 message, a simple default text is used. Saved GIFs are attached automatically, or place one yourself with the gif placeholder.
sectionDesc.goodbye: Send a message when members leave.

gates.goodbye: Do you want a message sent when members leave?

errors.embedNotFound: No saved embed with that name exists.
errors.componentsNotFound: No saved CV2 message with that name exists.
errors.manageGuildRequired: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.

gifs.count: {{total}} saved - page {{page}} of {{pages}}. A random one is attached to every message.
gifs.empty: Nothing saved yet. Right-click any message with an image and pick the "Save GIF" app command.
gifs.noneFound: That message has no images I can save.
gifs.alreadySaved: That image is already in the pool.
